The entire trip

Departure → arrival

Synthetic vehicle styles, editable after generation. Randomize uses this trip’s seed, replaces the curve and keeps your arrival. It sets extra speed variation to 0% because the generated points already vary. Set arrival from average uses the road distance plus stops. Average driving speed excludes stops.
